content.title: 过去分词(done)用法速查
content.intro: 过去分词 = 被动 + 完成。判断口诀:看逻辑主语是不是动作的承受者——是,就用 done(被动);自己主动发出动作才用 doing。过去分词可作定语、状语、宾语补足语和表语。

headers: 用法 / 例句 / 等价
rows: a ruined castle 一座荒废的城堡(= a castle that is ruined)
a bridge built in 1920 = a bridge which was built in 1920
Built of stone, the tower has lasted centuries.(= As it was built…)
Seen from the air, the site looks stunning.(= When it is seen…)
have/get sth done;see/find/keep sth done:keep the doors locked
the gate remained closed 大门一直关着(处于被动/完成状态)

specialRules.rule: 逻辑主语是承受者 → done(被动);主动发出动作 → doing
specialRules.mark: the bridge built(桥被建)vs the workers building(工人在建)

specialRules.rule: 作状语时,过去分词的逻辑主语必须是句子主语,且主语承受该动作
specialRules.mark: Located in the south, the town…(town 被定位)

specialRules.rule: have sth done:让/使某事被做(常含'请人做'或'遭遇')
specialRules.mark: had the bridge repaired 把桥修好了

specialRules.rule: see/find/keep/want + sth + done:宾语是动作承受者
specialRules.mark: found the gate blocked 发现门被堵住

why: 过去分词本身带有'被动'和'完成'两层含义,相当于把一个被动的定语从句或状语从句压缩成一个词;只要被修饰的名词/句子主语是动作的承受者,就用 done,而不是主动的 doing。
gaokaoPoints: 句首独立结构:Built/Located/Seen/Given… 后接逗号,主语承受动作时用过去分词,语法填空与读后续写高频。
done 与 doing 的对照:看名词/主语是被动(done)还是主动进行(doing)是判断核心。
have/get sth done、see/find/keep sth done 的宾补结构是写作与单选常考点。

examVsReal.exam: Built in 1920, the bridge is still in use.（考试/书面正式）
examVsReal.real: The bridge was built in 1920 and it's still used.
examVsReal.note: 考试爱用过去分词独立结构凝练;口语常拆成两个简单句

examVsReal.exam: He had his photo taken in front of the statue.（考试强调被动宾补）
examVsReal.real: He got a photo of himself by the statue.
examVsReal.note: 考试用 have sth done;日常口语换更随意的说法
